contracts.shared_evaluation: V5.1 scalar WSS; cv3 train/test 90/46,90/46,92/44; seed1234; full held-out wall clouds and all81 steps1120:2:1280; peak1162; raw Pa truth; ln=max(WSS,0.05)+eps1e-6; case-balanced R2 per frame then uniform-frame mean; TAWSS mean over81 frames; arithmetic three-fold means.
contracts.Tnull: No temporal fitting. Fold-trained mu/sigma form the analytic B_scale base from the same frozen X5D donor peak anchor. Use P0.10 metrics.eval_compatible, not its tnull_compatible block and not stage2 embedded tnull_*.
contracts.C-raw: 28-channel raw27+peak anchor to a 66,049-parameter point/phase MLP.4000 AdamW steps x8 cases x2048 queries x81 frames; samples from the full cached clouds, train stats from all cached training points; last; TF32 disabled. Versus r3: architecture, parameter count, optimization budget, pool coverage, normalization sample and numerics differ.
contracts.TL-warm: Donor-initialized geometry; only fp+local_wall_branch trainable (97,856 geometry params plus66,689 head,531,560 geometry frozen).150 epochs x12 batches=1800 steps; batch8 queries2048, drop_last=False; dynamic independent5000-point support and query resampling each epoch; density/noise augmentation disabled. Input stats from first4 initial training batches; lr geometry1e-4/head1e-3; last; fixed donor peak anchor. Versus r3, matching1800 iterations does not match query exposures, geometry updates, sampling or normalization.
contracts.T0: Fresh-random phase-conditioned PointNet++:27+4 input channels,630,056params,no fixed peak anchor.400 epochs, batch8; support/query5000 independently sampled per epoch; one sampled time per case/epoch (1/9 peak-forcing branch, otherwise uniform81); density augmentation p0.6.4800 batches/fold, not4800 effective optimizer steps because AMP overflow skipped5/5/4 updates. ckpt_best selected by train-loss EMA alpha0.2, zero-based epochs397/398/360. All-case/all-frame eval is raw Pa; stored run stats content equals same frame-stats files, but runtime split/stats SHA not recorded in metrics.
contracts.r3: Frozen same-fold cached X5D encoder. All arms have60D projector, identical initial tensors and120,769 time-model params; raw arm zeros normalized query_x32 channels, retains raw27+pretrained peak1.60x30=1800 AdamW steps x4 cases x1024 queries x81 frames; fixed8192 train query pool,4096 stats samples/case,1024 fixed context points/case; last; TF32 train true. The comparison is incremental cached representation / cross-time mixing, not pretrained-versus-random.
limitations: All references are development evidence on the same cv3 splits and one seed; no statistical significance, equivalence, or independent confirmation claim.
Original dataset paths and available metadata hashes match, but per-bundle raw-label byte identity across historical execution times was not recorded in these metric files.
Historical summaries are secondary indexes; all table values here are read from original metrics and checked against their summary.
Shared-GPU r3 training times must not be interpreted as a controlled architecture speed benchmark.
